typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk or Manrope for a structured, professional B2B look
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans or Inter for maximum legibility in dense dashboards
typography.rules: Never use Inter for Main/Sub headings. Tight letter spacing for headings. Left-align dense content.

colors.archetype: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Authority, Clarity, Truth) mixed with THE PERFORMANCE PRO for dashboard precision

palette.base: Stark White (#FFFFFF) for light, Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A) for dark
palette.primary: Signal Blue (#007AFF) or Trust Navy for CTAs
palette.accent: Warning Yellow and Signal Red for status indicators in O.S. and RMA

colors.rules: No generic full-screen gradients. Color is for function and guiding action. Tint neutral greys slightly with blue (cool). Banned colors for this project: #7351B7, #1B93A4

visual_enhancers.landing_page: Glassmorphism for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-black/60). Soft ambient shadows. Generous spacing (p-12 to p-32).
visual_enhancers.dashboard: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton with border-collapse style layout. 1px subtle borders on cards, flat surfaces without muddy shadows. Dense padding (p-4 to p-6).

components_strategy.marketing_pages: Custom HTML/Tailwind for layouts. Shadcn only for complex interactive logic. Use Bento grid mode A.
components_strategy.dashboard_area: Shadcn components heavily utilized (Tables, Dialogs, Select, Tabs, Forms). Go cardless where possible or use rectangular, dense, flat styles.
components_strategy.forms: Never use native input. Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select.

specific_features.signature_canvas: Use 'react-signature-canvas' package for the digital signature requirement in O.S.
specific_features.charts: Use Recharts (Shadcn Charts) for Dashboard metrics (weekly agenda load, garage usage).
specific_features.calendar: Use Shadcn Calendar or build a custom Kanban/Timeline with HTML/Tailwind for O.S. scheduling.

grids.marketing: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetrical. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gaps (gap-8).
grids.dashboard: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4, tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized.

layouts.structure: Sidebar navigation for the ERP module. Persistent but collapsible. Mobile shifts to bottom nav or hamburger.
layouts.tables: Must overflow horizontally on mobile with proper clipping and visual hints.

motion.rules: Minimalist in dashboard (micro-interactions for feedback). Staggered entrances for list items. Must respect prefers-reduced-motion.
motion.interactions: Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white). Button focus states require ring.

accessibility.contrast: APCA / WCAG AA standard. Min 4.5:1 for small text. 3:1 for large/interactive.
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-os-button').

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. Keep subjects clear.

image_urls.description: Business professionals collaborating - Ideal for 'About Us' or Landing Page Hero
Smart lock accessed via phone - Represents Residential Automation
Mobile app controlling smart lights - Great for Features/App Showcase
Warehouse and boxes - Represents the Estoque (Inventory) Module

responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first approach is MANDATORY. Design for small screens first, then scale up with sm:, md:, lg:.
responsive.layout: Grid layouts MUST collapse to 1 column on mobile. Dashboard tables convert to vertically stacked cards. ERP sidebar becomes a hamburger menu.
responsive.typography: Headings scale down on mobile (H1 max text-4xl). Input text must be text-base (16px) to prevent iOS zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Constrain flex/grid children. Prevent horizontal scrolling on the body. Use overflow-x-auto strictly on table containers.
responsive.tap_targets: All buttons, links, and form elements must be at least 44x44px for touch interfaces.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building for a React JavaScript (.js) environment, NOT TypeScript (.tsx). Adapt component generation accordingly.
Implement a mobile-first responsive approach. This is critical for the target audience.
DO NOT use a completely transparent background on headers or overlays. Use backdrop-blur-xl and semi-transparent colors (e.g. bg-white/70).
Include 'data-testid' attributes on ALL buttons, inputs, and clickable elements for automated testing.
The application requires custom JWT Auth and Stripe payment tiers ($100/mo, $250/3mo, $900/yr). Add UI scaffolding for these.
For the 'Agenda/O.S.' form, integrate 'react-signature-canvas' to allow clients to sign on-screen.
Build granular permission logic visually (e.g. grayed out tabs for employees lacking permission).
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the landing page (Bento grids, generous spacing), and Shadcn for the Dashboard (high data density, modular widgets).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky/floating elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties like opacity, transform, colors.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add text-align: center to the root App CSS.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, active presses.
Use generous padding (2-3x typical) for marketing areas. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
